test_coverage: Existing test coverage for language registration: test_get_language_info_known() verifies all languages in mod.rs return Some(LanguageInfo); test_language_for_extension_happy_path() in lang.rs verifies all extensions map correctly. Per-language tests: queries_compile() validates ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY; test_*_element_query_happy_path() verifies extraction of classes and functions; test_extract_inheritance() verifies inheritance extraction; test_defuse_query_*() verifies def-use site detection. New PHP handler must include all these test dimensions.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; grammar defines class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration, function_definition, method_declaration node types
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar uses base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) as child nodes, not fields. class_declaration has fields: name (required), body (required), attributes (optional). Functions are function_definition nodes; methods are method_declaration nodes inside class bodies. Enums supported via enum_declaration with enum_declaration_list body.

library_findings.relevant_api: Query, QueryCursor, Node, Language types; child_by_field_name(), named_child(), kind(), start_byte(), end_byte() methods
library_findings.notes: Used by all language handlers to parse and query syntax trees. Query::new() validates syntax at runtime. Captures are accessed via QueryCursor::matches() and QueryMatch::captures().

approaches.name: Approach 1: Minimal PHP handler (CSS-like, no defuse_query, no inheritance)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums) and CALL_QUERY only. No DEFUSE_QUERY, no inheritance extraction. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add tree-sitter-php dependency.
pros: Fastest to implement; minimal code surface
Works for basic symbol extraction and call graph
Follows CSS/YAML pattern for simpler languages
cons: No inheritance information for class hierarchies
Less useful for complex PHP codebases with traits and interfaces

approaches.name: Approach 2: Full PHP handler with DEFUSE_QUERY (Java-like, no inheritance)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, and DEFUSE_QUERY. No inheritance extraction. Covers local variable declarations, assignments, and identifier reads. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add tree-sitter-php dependency.
pros: Enables def-use tracking and semantic analysis
Defuse_query is required by the issue specification
cons: No inheritance extraction (less useful for OOP analysis)

approaches.name: Approach 3: Complete PHP handler with DEFUSE_QUERY and inheritance extraction (Swift-like, full featured)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and extract_inheritance() handler. Extract inheritance from base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) nodes. Add test suite covering all dimensions. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add tree-sitter-php dependency.
pros: Enables full semantic analysis including inheritance
Best for complex PHP OOP codebases

recommendation: Approach 3 (Complete PHP handler with DEFUSE_QUERY and inheritance extraction). The issue explicitly requests DEFUSE_QUERY support, which is required for def-use tracking. The Swift language addition (commit dbc2971) demonstrates that full handlers are the standard pattern for new languages. PHP's OOP features (classes, interfaces, traits, enums) warrant inheritance extraction. The additional complexity is minimal compared to the value gained for semantic analysis. Test coverage must include all 9+ dimensions identified in test_snippets.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
(
  (function_definition
    name: (name) @function_name) @function
  (method_declaration
    name: (name) @method_name) @function
  (class_declaration
    name: (name) @class_name) @class
  (interface_declaration
    name: (name) @interface_name) @class
  (trait_declaration
    name: (name) @trait_name) @class
  (enum_declaration
    name: (name) @enum_name) @class
)
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-php grammar (common/define-grammar.js): class_declaration node has optional child nodes base_clause (for 'extends' keyword followed by parent class names) and class_interface_clause (for 'implements' keyword followed by interface names). To extract inheritance: (1) walk child nodes of class_declaration, (2) find base_clause node and extract its name children as 'extends' entries, (3) find class_interface_clause node and extract its name children as 'implements' entries. interface_declaration and trait_declaration follow the same pattern with class_interface_clause for their parent interfaces/traits.
